provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Barrage rules summary, introductory game (Cranio Creations, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Map, Energy Track and Management board on the table
Excavators, Concrete Mixers, Credits and Water Drops in the general supply
Shuffle the Bonus tiles; 5 faceup on the Energy Track; 1 random Objective tile at the end of the track
Shuffle the National Contracts; {n} faceup on the Management board
Private Contract tiles facedown in piles with two faceup per pile
Neutral Dams in the marked basins: level 1 in the Mountains, 2 in the Hills, 3 in the Plains, each with 1 Water Drop behind it
Each player: a Company board, an Executive Officer tile, all pieces of a color and a Construction Wheel
Each player takes 6 Credits, 6 Excavators, 4 Concrete Mixers and their Starting Contract
Turn Order markers placed; Energy markers on the starting space; VP markers on 10
Patent Office and Advanced Technology tiles are not used in the introductory game
In turn order, place Engineers on an action space and resolve it
